sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS count
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M' AND strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956' AND L.CPK >= 250
